links.outcome: Safety ratings of fine-tuned SLM counseling outputs versus GPT-4o by psychiatrists
links.effect: GPT-4o had significantly higher safety scores than all SLMs (P<.001); the safety gap necessitates human expert oversight.
links.quote: GPT-4o maintained significantly higher safety scores than all SLMs (P<.001).

unlisted_practices: Fine-tuning small local language models on culturally specific data for culturally appropriate mental health counseling
On-premise small language model deployment for privacy preservation
Two-stage hybrid evaluation combining LLM-as-a-Judge screening with expert psychiatrist validation

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates culturally adapted small language models against GPT-4o for Korean mental health counseling using expert psychiatrist ratings and LLM-as-a-judge, but does not test a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
